name: Elegant
about: Elegant is a free, open-source icon set with 100 icons designed by Kenny Sing. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under GPL 3.0.

faqs.a: Yes. All 100 Elegant are open source under the GPL 3.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the GPL 3.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Elegant in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.
There are 100 icons in the Elegant set, designed by Kenny Sing. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Elegant?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Elegant available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
